purpose: Archive the validated observed opaque integer-arithmetic candidate and correctness, explicit compatibility reconciliation, and an unlaunched timing gate.

decision.next: Reproduce the scalar-first-element ListObj entry rejection with a single long call; preserve existing per-access fallback checks.

packing: Deterministic archives preserve original member paths and bytes. Executable binaries, build/frozen caches, generated standard-library dependency trees, and the live exporter log are excluded. All source identities, validation records, expected baseline failure, all four test-source versions, codegen, methods, complete census coverage, raw semantic evidence, and all validation outcomes and the unlaunched timing gate are retained. Final complete EXPORT.txt is added after export closes.

checkpoint_filter.purpose: Make cache-free checkpoint copies while preserving the original local archives.
checkpoint_filter.note: Only generated bytecode/cache members are omitted. Every remaining source, test, input, result, failure, and method retains its original bytes. The original manifest is inside the filtered archive. Historical reports and EXPORT logs describe the original archive; use this checkpoint manifest for the committed copies.
